svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/requirements_readme.py from requirements/SYS-*.yaml, safety/hazards/ and architecture/item-definition.yaml. Candidate requirements: not baselined, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · BMS = battery management system · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support,

maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage,

distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record
